svg.title: SSO through standard provider endpoints
svg.desc: Browser; FastGPT; Provider system. browser → app: Get authorization URL; app → idp: GET getAuthURL; idp → app: authURL; app → browser: Authorization URL; browser → idp: Redirect and log in; idp → browser: Redirect to callback; browser → app: Submit callback params; app → idp: GET getUserInfo; idp → app: Standard user info; app → browser: Login result

g.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
